messages:
ela (marketing): quick sync — spun up an accepted-run simulation for the big webinar list. goal: validate handoff SLOs and eliminate default-owner fallthrough. results below.

tara (ops): curious what traffic profile you used?

ela (marketing): 1.6k leads/min sustained for 4m with bursts to 3k/min. we toggled enrichment_timeout = 1s and then 1.6s to compare.

cheng (sales-ops): what fellthrough % at 1s?

ela (marketing): with 1s TTL fallthrough ~8.6%. with 1.6s TTL fell to ~2.9% but duplicates cropped up when enrichment returned after default assign.

ade (growth): duplicates are bad. can we prefer a "hold-and-warm" path instead of immediate default assignment during campaign windows?

tara (ops): yes. suggested change to claim worker logic:
```
startClaim();
triggerEnrichment();
if (!enrichment.done) {
  if (queue_depth > QD_THRESHOLD && campaign.flag.high_surge) {
    routeToWarmPool(); // short-term SDR pool
  } else {
    waitUpTo(SOFT_HOLD_MS);
    if (!enrichment.done && now - start > ENR_TTL) fallbackToDefault();
  }
} else assignNormalOwner();
```
Set SOFT_HOLD_MS=350 when queue_depth>40.

cheng (sales-ops): sales input: warm pool owners are SDRs who triage quickly. we'll create SF rule that maps campaign.metadata.warm_route = true -> owner = "sdrcampaign-warm". also add dedupe on enrichment callback: use external_id + campaign_id to upsert instead of create.

ade (growth): growth will mark webinar templates with campaign.metadata.high_surge=true and campaign.metadata.warm_route=true when applicable.

ela (marketing): runbook proposal (rapid-response):
- Pre-run: flag campaign.high_surge and warm_route.
- During spike: if fallthrough_rate > 2% flip soft-hold on and bump enrichment_timeout to 1.6s.
- If duplicates > 0 after run -> enable enrichment upsert dedupe and run a short cleanup job.
- Post-run: audit fallthrough_by_campaign, dupes, enrichment_latency_95p, queue_depth.

tara (ops): telemetry to add ASAP:
- metric: handoff.fallthrough.rate by campaign
- metric: enrichment.queue_depth
- metric: enrichment.latency.p95 by region
- alert: handoff.fallthrough.rate > 2% for 3m
- alert: enrichment.queue_depth > 60 for 2m

deploy-bot: rollout plan ready: feature-flag 'hold-warm-route' -> staging 10% (15m) -> prod 100% if canary metrics green.

tara (ops): i'll open the PR today for soft-hold + warm routing and include canary dashboards. tagging eng-infra and sales-ops in the PR.

cheng (sales-ops): i'll draft the SF mapping and dedupe guidance and add to the campaign template doc.

ade (growth): will propagate the flags to the webinar templates and brief event producers.

ela (marketing): logging this thread to campaign-runbook/inbound-runbook. follow-ups: run a targeted canary (1k leads/min for 5m) with warm_route enabled and report fallthrough & dupes. thanks all! :rocket:
